modifiers_target_scope_consistent.name: modifiers_target_scope_consistent
modifiers_target_scope_consistent.value: ("modifiers"."target_scope" = 'ALL' AND "modifiers"."target_module_id" IS NULL) OR ("modifiers"."target_scope" = 'MODULE' AND "modifiers"."target_module_id" IS NOT NULL)

modifiers_operation_complete.name: modifiers_operation_complete
modifiers_operation_complete.value: ("modifiers"."operation_kind" IS NULL AND "modifiers"."operation_params" IS NULL) OR ("modifiers"."operation_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "modifiers"."operation_params" IS NOT NULL)

opportunities_date_order.name: opportunities_date_order
opportunities_date_order.value: "opportunities"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "opportunities"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "opportunities"."starts_at" <= "opportunities"."ends_at"

opportunities_validity_order.name: opportunities_validity_order
opportunities_validity_order.value: "opportunities"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "opportunities"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "opportunities"."valid_from" <= "opportunities"."valid_to"
